bibl.title: Marital Crises or institutional crises? Two Ptolemaic couples under the spotlight.
bibl.seg: Anne Bielman Sánchez & Virginie Joliton, Marital Crises or institutional crises? Two Ptolemaic couples under the spotlight.
Anne Bielman Sánchez (ed.), Power Couples in Antiquity: Transversal Perspectives = Routledge Monographs in Classical Studies (London, 2019) pp. 69-98, figg.
bibl.note: Examine two royal Ptolemaic couples who, according to some classical sources, were reputed to have experienced serious marital crises: the couple Ptolemy IV and Arsinoe III, who ruled during the end of the third century BCE, and the couple Ptolemy VIII and Cleopatra II from the second century BCE.
